summary: Learn practical AI for legal review, compliance controls, and contract analysis. Build workflows, policies, and dashboards.
lede: AI for legal, compliance and contract review helps legal and compliance professionals organize document assessment and risk-aware review workflows. For counsel, contract managers, compliance officers, legal operations specialists and paralegals, the training covers prompt design for clause extraction, playbook-based risk assessment and validation of AI-generated content; exercises also address internal knowledge retrieval, e-discovery triage and governance controls.
audienceIntro: This AI for Legal, Compliance and Contract Review course is built for professionals who need to review documents, govern AI use, and support risk-aware legal decision-making in live workflows. In-house counsel managing commercial contract review and clause risk. Contract managers maintaining playbooks, fallback positions, and redline standards. Compliance officers mapping AI use to internal controls and review obligations. Legal operations specialists streamlining review workflows and matter intake. Paralegals supporting contract triage, extraction, and first-pass analysis. Corporate legal analysts tracking review metrics and turnaround times. Risk and compliance managers aligning contract controls with policy requirements. E-discovery specialists applying AI-supported review discipline and defensibility. Procurement specialists negotiating vendor terms and data-processing clauses. Governance, risk, and compliance professionals coordinating legal AI controls.
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of legal workflows, contract structures, and document review processes. Familiarity with legal research databases, contract lifecycle management basics, and corporate compliance terminology is required. No prior coding experience is required, but a modern web browser and a laptop are required for hands-on prompt engineering and AI review exercises. Experience with Microsoft Word, clause libraries, and matter management workflows will help you move faster. Advanced concepts such as RAG, predictive coding, and AI monitoring are taught at an operational application level, not as software engineering content.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
